item.title: Weekday 13 November
item.description: Overcast sixteen turning warm with a three-in-four chance of rain, a rest day on the cut, and a clean run to RPAH. The Extra Shot pours over Jensen Huang's confirmed Nvidia exit, Anthropic's IPO roadshow, and Google's new Decisions API - plus pollen sits low, the calendar sits empty, and the bargains run from free cheeseburgers to a price-beat Switch 2.

item.title: Thursday 12 November
item.description: A postcard spring morning and a quiet Camperdown calendar. Pollen note for the snuffly, a hinge-habit fitness tip, and a quote to close: hinge today, stand taller all week.
